ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with a high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixel ratio of approximately 5-7% localized to discrete circular markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white punctate blobs (approx. 5-20 pixels diameter) scattered across both lobes; highest concentration observed in the distal half of the left lobe and along the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an interior angle of approximately 42 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 10% of the visible vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (2-4 pixel deviations) along the continuous boundary; notable macro-irregularity and jaggedness on the distal third of both the left and right lobe trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning into an upward-sloping convex trajectory toward the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular pixel clusters (3-15 pixels) distributed across the ventral surface, with heavy clusters located at the terminal tips and the medial section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme jaggedness and irregular pixel clusters on the distal tips of both lobes, suggesting heavy barnacle colonization or localized tissue trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Base of the fluke and peduncle insertion point is entirely obscured by high-intensity white pixel saturation caused by water spray/splash.
